meta.name: aeon
meta.description: This skill should be used for time series machine learning tasks including classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, anomaly detection, segmentation, and similarity search. Use when working with temporal data, sequential patterns, or time-indexed observations requiring specialized algorithms beyond standard ML approaches. Particularly suited for univariate and multivariate time series analysis with scikit-learn compatible APIs.

copy.tagline: 完成时间序列数据的分类、预测与异常识别
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有按时间顺序记录的数据,想预测走向或发现问题
copy.tagline_en: Build forecasting, classification and anomaly detection models on time-stamped data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have time-stamped data and want to forecast trends or spot unusual patterns.

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 会改用 Python 的 aeon 工具包处理时间序列(按时间记录的一串数值),做分类、预测或异常检测等分析,并给出预测值、分类标签、异常得分等结果。
howto.when: 当数据是按时间先后记录的一串数值,且任务涉及分类、预测或异常点发现等时间序列分析时触发。

say.text: 用 aeon 对这个时间序列做分类,比较两个模型的准确率
say.note: 会分别训练并给出准确率。

say.text: 用 aeon 对过去 30 天的数据做预测,输出未来 7 天数值
say.note: 会拟合预测模型再输出未来值。

say.text: 用 aeon 找出这段心电数据中的异常片段

howto.what_en: Claude can use the aeon Python toolkit on time-indexed numeric sequences for classification, forecasting, or anomaly detection, and produce labels, predicted values, or anomaly scores.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the data is a time-ordered numeric sequence and the user asks for classification, forecasting, anomaly detection, or similar time-series analysis.

say_en.text: Classify this time series with aeon and compare two models' accuracy.
say_en.note: It will train both and report accuracy.

say_en.text: Use aeon to forecast the next 7 days from the last 30 days of data.
say_en.note: It will fit a forecaster and return future values.

say_en.text: Use aeon to find anomalous segments in this ECG data.
say_en.note: It returns an anomaly score per time point.
